subject: Web Development
title: The Return of Multi-Page Apps
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Return of Multi-Page Apps.

hook.text: For a decade, SPAs dominated. Now some developers are going back to multi-page architectures.

buildup.text: Frameworks like Astro and Enhance generate traditional HTML pages with minimal JavaScript.

discovery.text: The View Transitions API makes page navigations feel as smooth as SPA transitions.

twist.text: MPAs are simpler to build, easier to cache, and more accessible than complex SPAs.

climax.text: The pendulum is swinging — simplicity and server rendering are fashionable again.

quiz.question: What API makes MPA transitions smooth?
